eval_suites.name: workflow-routing-eval
eval_suites.success_metric: all recipe cases select the expected workflow recipe, negative examples do not route to self, and all skill-route cases select exactly one primary skill
eval_suites.promotion_gate: new workflow recipes or skill-route matrices require positive, negative, primary, supporting, and fallback routing evidence before promotion

eval_suites.name: governance-contract-eval
eval_suites.success_metric: optional governance manifests pass valid fixtures and reject unsafe or inconsistent fixtures
eval_suites.promotion_gate: new governance manifest classes require pass and reject tests before source-to-live apply

eval_suites.name: official-docs-freshness-eval
eval_suites.success_metric: official-docs-derived guidance has OpenAI source URLs, retrieved_at, review_status, expires_at, stale action and rollback before promotion
eval_suites.promotion_gate: OpenAI official guidance cannot be promoted to AGENTS, skill bodies or workflow recipes while freshness metadata is missing or stale

eval_suites.name: completion-gate-eval
eval_suites.success_metric: final-ready and check.sh complete with explicit evidence before final, commit, push or apply
eval_suites.promotion_gate: delivery claims must be backed by final-ready plus check.sh evidence

eval_suites.name: wechat-account-research-eval
eval_suites.success_metric: bounded WeChat account research produces metadata-only evidence, preserves negative states, stops on access gates and rejects unbounded query plans
eval_suites.promotion_gate: the workflow cannot enter source-to-live when body persistence, signed URLs, proxy or identity rotation, automatic promotion, or access-gate retries are possible

eval_suites.name: local-runtime-boundary-eval
eval_suites.success_metric: local permission profiles, exec rules and hook contracts reject broad access, open network defaults and unenforceable hook claims
eval_suites.promotion_gate: local runtime boundary changes must pass governance validation and Codex strict-config doctor before source-to-live apply
